tasks.description: Complete end-to-end validation of Trailblaze Auto covering public catalogue access, vehicle details, admin authentication, vehicle management, and booking lifecycle with strict validation and access control.
acceptance_criteria: Navigate to home Verify hero text 'Elegance for' Verify 'Catalogue' link visibility using ID #browse-link.
Click 'Catalogue' Verify redirect to /browse Verify vehicle grid is rendered using ID #car-grid.
Inspect car card Verify brand, name, and price are rendered with correct IDs #car-card-{id}, #car-card-{id}-brand, #car-card-{id}-name, and #car-card-{id}-price.
Click any vehicle card Verify navigation to /car/[id] Verify dynamic data loads using ID #car-card-{id}.
On car details, click 'Specs' tab Verify Transmission is visible Click 'Overview' tab Verify System (Fuel Type) is visible.
On /browse, select 'New' filter Verify only 'Brand New' status cars are visible using ID article[id^="car-card-"] and class .badge.
On /browse, select 'Pre-Owned' filter Verify only 'Pre-Owned' status cars are visible using ID article[id^="car-card-"] and class .badge.
Click 'All' filter Verify grid resets to display complete vehicle inventory using ID #car-grid.
For 'Used' car, click 'Price' tab Verify 'Financial Breakdown' and 'Owner Depreciation' sections.

Signup at /admin/signup Fill fields Verify toast 'Account created successfully' and redirect to /admin using IDs #admin-signup-name, #admin-signup-email, #admin-signup-password, and #admin-signup-button.
Login at /admin with valid credentials Verify toast 'Access Granted.' Verify redirection to /admin/dashboard using IDs #admin-email-input, #admin-password-input, and #admin-login-button.
Login at /admin with invalid credentials Verify toast 'Authentication failed.' using IDs #admin-email-input, #admin-password-input, and #admin-login-button.
Clear token Navigate directly to /admin/dashboard Verify redirect to /admin using localStorage.
Load Admin Dashboard Verify 'Inventory Overview' and 'Incoming Requests' are rendered.

Open 'Add Car' Fill New vehicle fields Click 'Save Vehicle' Verify toast 'Vehicle added successfully!' and redirection using IDs #brand-select, #model-select, #year-select, #car-price-input, and #main-image-input.

Open 'Add Car' Select 'Used' Fill owners/history Verify record persistence using IDs #brand-select, #model-select, #year-select, #owners-count-input, #car-price-input, #registration-city-input, and #main-image-input.
In 'Add Car', leave 'Car Name' empty Click 'Next Step' Verify toast 'Please fill in all basic information' and block using ID #brand-select.
Open 'Edit Car' Modify price Verify toast 'Vehicle updated successfully!' Verify reflected on public page using ID #car-price-input.
In Admin Dashboard, click 'Sign Out' Verify toast 'Logged out successfully' Verify redirect to home.
Navigate to /admin/profile Update Name/Bio Click 'Synchronize Profile Data' Verify toast 'Profile updated successfully!'.
In Profile, clear 'Full Legal Name' Click 'Synchronize' Verify HTML5 validation block.
Update password in Profile Sync data Verify login works with new password using IDs #admin-email-input, #admin-password-input, and #admin-login-button.
On car details, click 'Book Now' Verify 'PurchaseModal' opens with vehicle info using ID #book-now-main-button.
In 'PurchaseModal', fill valid data Submit Verify API 201 and record creation using ID #book-now-main-button.
Submit valid booking Verify toast 'Booking request sent!' Verify modal automatically closes using IDs #book-now-main-button, #purchase-name, #purchase-email, #purchase-contact, and #purchase-submit.

In 'PurchaseModal', enter invalid email Submit Verify toast 'Please enter a valid email address.' using IDs #book-now-main-button, #purchase-email, #purchase-name, #purchase-contact, and #purchase-submit.
Submit booking twice with same email Verify API 400 and toast 'already exists' using IDs #book-now-main-button, #purchase-name, #purchase-email, #purchase-contact, and #purchase-submit.
Open Admin 'Bookings' tab Verify customer requests are listed correctly.

Locate pending booking Click 'Accept' Verify status 'Accepted' and toast 'Booking accepted!' using IDs #book-now-main-button, #purchase-name, #purchase-email, #purchase-contact, #purchase-submit, #admin-bookings-tab, #booking-row-{id}, and #booking-row-{id}-accept.

Locate pending booking Click 'Reject' Verify status 'Rejected' and toast 'Booking rejected!' using IDs #book-now-main-button, #purchase-name, #purchase-email, #purchase-contact, #purchase-submit, #admin-bookings-tab, #booking-row-{id}, and #booking-row-{id}-reject.
Navigate to /car/invalid-id-999 Verify 'Vehicle Not Found' message and 'Back to Fleet' button.
On empty DB, open 'Bookings' tab Verify 'No active bookings.' message.
On /browse, search for specific brand Verify grid filters matching vehicles using ID article[id^="car-card-"] and div[id$="-brand"].
On Accepted booking, click 'Edit Status' Change to Rejected Verify status update and toast.

In 'PurchaseModal', enter 9-digit contact Submit Verify toast 'Please enter a valid phone number (min 10 digits).' using IDs #book-now-main-button, #purchase-name, #purchase-email, #purchase-contact, and #purchase-submit.
In 'Add Car', enter price below $100 Save Verify toast 'Price must be at least $100' using ID #car-price-input.
In Profile, enter invalid email Sync Verify toast 'Please enter a valid email address.'.
Clear token Navigate directly to /admin/add-car Verify redirect to /admin using localStorage.

In 'PurchaseModal', enter 1-character name Submit Verify toast 'Please enter a valid full name (min 2 characters)' using IDs #book-now-main-button, #purchase-name, #purchase-email, #purchase-contact, and #purchase-submit.
